intro: Laos is a one-party communist state led by the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The party controls the government, and other parties are not allowed. The National Assembly is elected but almost all members belong to the party.

chapters.title: Neighbours
text: Laos has close ties with Vietnam and China, which built the fast railway from Kunming to Vientiane.

keyTerms.meaning: Only one party is allowed to rule.
